item.title: Spec-driven development: From vibe coding to intent engineering
item.description: This gap between speed and strategic control is becoming one of the defining challenges for technology leadership, and spec-driven development (SDD) is emerging as the structured solution. It puts formal specification back at the center of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

item.title: Resilient by design: Connecting cybersecurity and digital sovereignty in manufacturing
item.description: Digital infrastructure is no longer just an efficiency enabler. It is a strategic asset that underpins resilience, trust and long-term competitiveness. As a result, cybersecurity and digital sovereignty can no longer be addressed separately. They are deeply interconnected, shaping not only how organizations protect themselves, but also how they participate in digital ecosystems and data spaces.

item.title: 2025 CGI and BAFT survey results: Realigning trade finance for a new era
item.description: Discover insights on the direction of trade finance from the 2025 CGI and BAFT trade finance survey in this CGI blog.

item.title: How AI drives business value for large utilities
item.description: While many professionals utilize ChatGPT or Gemini for everyday tasks, such as decoding lengthy meeting minutes or staying on top of their inboxes, the true transformative power for the industry lies in applying these tools at scale across utility operations.

item.title: Optimization, GenAI and quantum: Making complex supply chain decisions faster and more accessible
item.description: The most challenging part of optimization isn’t running the model. It’s building a model that reflects business realities fast enough to support operational decisions.

item.title: Proactive monitoring in retail: Stop loss of sales and improve store operations
item.description: In this blog, we explore how a proactive approach to monitoring across retail operations can help you identify issues earlier, minimize disruptions and give your team more time to focus on customer service.

item.title: From reactive to predictive: How AI is redefining financial planning and analysis
item.description: Learn how AI transforms financial planning and analysis from a reporting function into a predictive and prescriptive decision platform.

item.title: The AI value paradox: Measuring what matters (not just what’s easy)
item.description: Learn insights on the importance of measuring the value of AI, separate from hype, fear, and the vague promise that “AI will fix it.”

item.title: Transaction banking in 2026: Why client satisfaction no longer guarantees loyalty
item.description: Transaction banking is entering a paradoxical moment. Client satisfaction has never been higher, yet client loyalty has never been weaker. Further, transaction banks are shifting from growth-driven partnerships to risk-driven diversification.

item.title: Five insights guiding retail decisions in 2026
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) and agentic commerce are speeding up how customers discover, decide and purchase, while also changing how planning, fulfillment and cost structures work internally. The question executives are now asking is how to apply these capabilities without undermining financial discipline or customer trust.
